Run-specific limits

  • Retrieval relevance only; answer generation was not evaluated.
  • Public benchmark; pretraining contamination is unknown.
  • BEIR test is original SciFact public dev; it is not the hidden test.
  • RRF latency is the sum of measured serial component work, not a separate request.
  • BM25 has no stemming/stopwords; results are this implementation, not official BEIR baselines.

Relevance judgments are the benchmark, not a complete description of usefulness. Queries without positive judgments are excluded by the evaluator; missing rankings for eligible queries count as zero. A better aggregate can still hide important failures.
